name: Las Vegas
living: the pyramid's sky beam pulses gently and its light slowly breathes
the WELCOME TO VEGAS sign's marquee bulbs chase around its border
the starburst atop the sign twinkles and the sign's neon buzzes with a rare soft flicker
the Eiffel-style tower's gold lights sparkle in slow waves
the neon hot-air-balloon sign glows and its stripes shimmer
the observation wheel's rim lights slowly rotate
casino tower windows and billboard screens flicker and change colour
stars twinkle in the black desert sky
an airliner with blinking lights crosses the sky now and then
palm trees beyond the wall sway gently in the warm desert night air
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
